title: Humphreys Field Guide — consolidated visitor-purpose legend
scope: Classification and presentation contract for 648 canonical places; no place deletion, re-geocoding, field cleanup or asserted live-map completion.

stateLimits.note: Historical native IDs and category values are evidence from saved snapshots, not a fresh map readback. A null nativeId is deliberately unknown. This contract makes no claim that its categories or physical consolidation have been applied.

groups.label: Food & Drink / 음식·카페
groups.definition: Restaurants, bakeries, cafés, bars and food/drink visits. Board-game cafés and animal-experience cafés remain recreation when the venue record is specifically about that activity.

groups.label: Nature & Camping / 자연·캠핑
groups.definition: Parks, botanical gardens, forests, walking scenery, beaches/coastlines/harbors, campgrounds and glamping. Camping type and overnight eligibility are details, not extra legend categories.

groups.label: Activities & Wellness / 체험·휴식
groups.definition: Sports, games, cinema, workshops, recreation, family play and learning attractions, theme/animal parks, ticketed leisure rides, spas and bathing. No separate bowling, billiards, darts, games, cinema, family or spa legend.

groups.label: Shopping / 쇼핑
groups.definition: Retail-first stores, malls, outlets, household/warehouse shopping, traditional markets and verified hobby/console retailers. Dining or entertainment tenants do not convert the parent shopping venue into an activity record.

groups.label: Culture & Sights / 문화·관광
groups.definition: Art/history museums, heritage sites, shrines, temples, churches, traditional culture, performances and built sightseeing landmarks. Religious denomination stays in details, not a separate legend.

groups.label: Restricted Access / 출입 제한
groups.definition: Access-warning presentation override for the two military-installation venues only; not a sixth ordinary visitor purpose.

mixedUseRules.reason: Retail and gaming/painting tables are both documented; retail dominance is unestablished. Retain the reviewed gaming presentation, now merged into Activities & Wellness, and retain retail in details. This is not a claim about customer or revenue dominance.
Explicit gaming/painting space with no retail; retain guardian, authentication and reservation restrictions.
Guided gaming or tournament use is documented; do not assume current walk-in table access or retail stock.
Whole-market records remain Shopping. Produce, goods, local-food purchases, food squares and snacks are retained as details; food facilities alone do not change the whole-market primary purpose.
These records describe animal companionship/viewing/play outings; café service is secondary.

Mixed ecological, interpretive and family-learning uses retain the reviewed family-purpose grouping, now consolidated. All distinctions and separately reserved sessions remain explicit in descriptions.

mixedUseRules.rule: Science and child-focused learning attractions remain consolidated under Activities & Wellness; the explicit history/industrial/railway/currency/tax-museum exceptions use Culture & Sights. Classification does not promise interactive facilities or inclusive admission to every session.

preservation.canonical: Keep existing category, kind and every existing field intact; use an additive presentation mapping/configuration. Do not flatten or replace subtype-rich records.
preservation.map: Change only separately authorized Category/style/structural presentation. Preserve all other existing fields, native identity, marker geometry, unresolved state and place count.
preservation.details: Keep full addresses/floors/units, five-language descriptions and notes, sources, checked dates, all subtypes, camping details, booking/eligibility/age/guardian/payment/access and uncertainty warnings. Move no detail into a microcategory legend and silently drop none.
preservation.restricted: Both restricted military venues retain the red warning triangle 1541-FF5252 and complete existing access warnings. A pin is not permission to enter.
preservation.identity: Use stable canonical IDs and only explicit native Record ID joins. Null native IDs and the original 311 missing joins must not be filled from name similarity, address similarity, counts or row order.

structuralTarget.description: Five ordinary-purpose layers plus a two-record restricted-access warning layer, or an equivalent supported single global legend. Matching colors repeated across legacy layers do not constitute completion.
structuralTarget.ifSafeMoveIsUnavailable: Stop and report the blocker; never blank fields, delete/reimport or remove warnings to force consolidation.

applicationGates: Read the current saved/reloaded full map inventory before applying; historical 607-row evidence does not establish current map state.
Reconcile every intended canonical/native identity using explicit supported evidence. Keep missing joins unknown; unknown raw Category values require review.
Snapshot all current field values, IDs, layer membership, styles and available marker/error evidence. Verify exact preservation of non-Category fields after changes.
Preserve all 648 intended places and all existing unresolved locations; verify no unexpected deletion, duplicate, address change or marker movement.
After save and reload, verify six exact presentation labels globally, the projected counts, and both red-triangle restrictions; verify structural consolidation separately from styling.
Retain a reversible audit of the actual before/after state and report incomplete coverage honestly.
